output.subject: We've received your complaint about the interest charge on your credit card statement
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for speaking with us about your credit card statement. We have received your complaint, and we want to confirm what you told us.

You mentioned that your statement shows an interest charge of $31.07, even though you paid your previous statement balance of $987.12 in full on 9/1. You told us that this interest was never disclosed to you, and you have asked for the $31.07 charge to be reversed.

We understand how frustrating it can be to see a charge you weren't expecting after paying your balance in full, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, and we will respond to you within 10 business days. If there are any statements, letters or other details you would like us to consider, please let us know and we will make sure they are included in the review.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Complaint came from a call-center note; confirm the customer's preferred contact channel before sending.
Confirm the $31.07 amount, the $987.12 payment amount and the 9/1 payment date against the account.
The call note shows the matter was escalated to a supervisor for a possible courtesy reversal; check whether a decision was already made or communicated on the call.
Decide whether the reversal request will be granted; the draft acknowledges the request without committing to an outcome.
Review what disclosures the customer received about interest after paying in full, given their claim it was never disclosed.
Draft intentionally does not repeat the representative's explanation of the charge; add it only if appropriate.
